Needs changes before merge.

The source review found no code defect. Two requirements from current upstream main remain open.

What passed:
- The MCP view and patch use `edm.codes` consistently.
- The edit validates the codes before the undoable mount.
- The tests cover merge, readback, undo, redo, removal, refusal, and MCP posting.
- The project machine schema stays unchanged.

The review used `.claude/worktrees/review-3223` with its own target directory. No GitHub runner was used.

Extra suites run: the two light tests above. No extra fixture or importer suite was required.
The diff changes no fixture, golden, importer, or kernel source.
The diff changes no UI source. Screenshots are not required.

Safety checks:

This patch changes the EDM control codes that can reach posted G-code.
I repeated two mutations in the local worktree:
1. Restore both old production files: both new tests failed. Restore the PR files: both passed.
2. Restore only the old readback: the flow test failed at `merge keeps other codes`. Restore the PR file: both passed.

The first mutation refused the valid patch with `unknown key 'edm.codes'`.
The second mutation returned `Null` instead of `FX-COND {id}`.
The final source matches the reviewed head. No golden changed, so there were no moved golden lines to check.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs:112` — Supply the required heavy-lane results for the final head.
   The heavy dry run selects every app heavy target: 200 steps, including the release build.
   The PR body reports only the quick gate and clippy. It names no completed heavy lane.
   Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` locally. Record the lanes and their results in the PR body.
   Current upstream `AGENTS.md:628` requires these results before the PR becomes ready.
   Heavy lanes were not run in this review. The dry run is not a pass.
2. `crates/app/src/mcp/machine_tools.rs:92` — Raise issue #3212 to at least `effort:high` and correct the PR body's effort statement.
   The edited codes become machine control text during posting. The issue and body currently state `effort:medium`.
   Current upstream `AGENTS.md:249` sets `effort:high` as the minimum for work that can change posted G-code.
   This review used the safety tier. The reviewer did not change issue labels.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Missing heavy-lane results: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed all 200 steps locally. The PR body now records the lanes and results. Tests reported 43 passes and four registered expected failures (#2849 and #1950). No unexpected test failed.
2. Effort below the safety floor: issue #3212 now has `effort:high`. The PR body explains that EDM control codes can change posted G-code.

Final head: `660cbf989ccd106bc37def1958104a2c4dc50fc9` (unchanged). The plain push reported that the branch was up to date.

The quick gate passed all 22 steps and 388 tests. Clippy passed for all app targets with warnings denied.
No source or test change was required. The existing pins and mutation results remain valid. The tracked tree stayed clean.

Please re-review this head and the updated PR body.

I repeated two mutations in the local trial merge:

1. Restore the old edit and readback behavior. Both new tests failed. The valid patch was refused with `unknown key 'edm.codes'`. Restoring the fix passed both tests.
